events.title: Santa Barbara posts draft Residential Rent Stabilization and Rental Registry ordinance for Sept. 22 introduction
events.impact: Would add a new local rent-stabilization and rental-registry layer if adopted; monitor coverage, cap formula, exemptions and implementation date.

events.title: Alameda City Council considers amendments to its rent-control ordinance concerning permanent relocation payments
events.impact: Does not change the basic rent cap by itself, but can change landlord cost and enforcement exposure on covered terminations.

events.title: Los Angeles RSO-related interim-control ordinance for Valley Glen becomes effective
events.impact: Adds a locality-specific restriction tied to permits/demolition around RSO housing; relevant to redevelopment optionality rather than a new citywide rent cap.

events.title: Pasadena opens 2026 rental-registration cycle with updated portal and 2.5% 2026-27 AGA
events.impact: Raises compliance visibility for covered units; annual registration is mandatory and the 2.5% AGA takes effect Oct. 1, 2026.
events.source: City of Pasadena Rent Stabilization Department

events.title: Jersey City releases Phase I of first citywide rent-control audit covering more than 1,700 properties and 20,000 units
events.impact: Materially increases enforcement visibility and legal-rent scrutiny; Phase II focuses on properties claiming exemptions without adequate documentation.

events.title: West Hollywood continues stakeholder review of potential Rent Stabilization Ordinance and enforcement-procedure updates
events.impact: Watch for changes to administrative procedures, enforcement and ordinance clarity rather than assuming the existing rent formula itself is changing.

events.title: Danbury Fair Rent Commission agenda includes active 2026 cases
events.impact: Illustrates Connecticut's complaint-driven local fair-rent layer; commission activity can affect proposed increases even without a fixed percentage cap.

events.title: NYC 2026-27 rent-stabilized renewal period begins with a 0% increase for one- and two-year renewals
events.impact: Directly constrains renewal growth for covered stabilized apartments during the Oct. 1, 2026–Sep. 30, 2027 guideline period.

events.title: Takoma Park schedules public meeting on potential rent-stabilization policy updates
events.impact: Current 3% allowance remains in force for Jul. 2026–Jun. 2027, while the city reviews possible program modifications for 2027.
